fhtid.title: FHT ID of the CUL
fhtid.description: The CUL has no FHT ID yet. FHT80b thermostats are paired to this ID. A random one is proposed. It must differ from any other FHT central (another CUL, FHEM) within radio range. If your FHT80b were paired to an old CUL, enter its ID (FHEM: attribute fhtid).

error.invalid_fhtid: Use 4 hex digits other than 0000, e.g. 1034.

abort.already_in_progress: Setup of this CUL is already in progress.

pair.title: Pair FHT80b
pair.description:
1. On the FHT80b: hold PROG until "Sond", turn to "CEnt", set it to nA, confirm with PROG.
2. Read code 1 and code 2 on the FHT80b under "CodE" (e.g. 028 and 080) and enter them here.

The CUL sends a request once. The FHT80b picks it up within about 2 min, then CEnt shows On.

progress.pairing: Waiting for FHT80b {code} (up to 15 min). CEnt on the FHT80b must show nA. You can close this dialog: a notification shows the result.

abort.paired: FHT80b {code} is paired. CEnt shows On, values arrive within the next minutes.
abort.pair_failed: FHT80b {code} did not answer. Check the code and CEnt nA. If old commands are stuck in the CUL, press "Restart" on the CUL device and try again.

fht_set_holiday.name: Set holiday
fht_set_holiday.description: Sets holiday mode with end time and temperature on an FHT80b.

mode.name: Mode
mode.description: holiday (end date) or holiday_short (end time on a day).

fht_set_schedule.name: Set schedule
fht_set_schedule.description: Sets the weekly program of one day. Omitted fields keep their value, empty fields are unused.

fht_refresh.name: Refresh values
fht_refresh.description: Asks the FHT80b to report its values again.

fht_sync_time.name: Sync clock
fht_sync_time.description: Sets the FHT80b clock to the current time.

fht_report.name: Request report
fht_report.description: Sends report requests to the FHT80b.

send_raw.name: Send raw command
send_raw.description: Sends a raw culfw command line to the CUL. Admins only.

config_entry_id.name: CUL
config_entry_id.description: Which CUL to use. Empty means all.

confirm.name: Confirm
confirm.description: Required to send T01… (changes the FHT ID, all FHT80b must be paired again).

fht_pair.name: Pair FHT80b
fht_pair.description: Pairs an FHT80b with the CUL. First set CEnt on the FHT80b to nA. The CUL sends one request; the FHT80b picks it up within about 2 min and CEnt shows On. A notification shows the result (timeout 15 min). Also available under the CUL's Configure.

code.name: Code
code.description: Code 1 and code 2 of the FHT80b as shown under "CodE", e.g. 028 080. 4 hex digits (1c50) work too.

config_entry_id.name: CUL
config_entry_id.description: Which CUL to use. Needed only with several CULs.
